categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and modifies `test/functional/feature_block.py` to add coverage for consensus validation.
categories.rationale: Adds functional test coverage for BIP30 enforcement on non-coinbase transactions, closing an untested consensus path. As noted in the description, mutant 4389 modified `ConnectBlock` in `validation.cpp` to check BIP30 only on `block.vtx[0]` and went uncaught; this provides a realistic regression test without blocking other work.
